title: Upper pullback in an open Cartesian square preserves K-injectives
statement: Let $X',X,Y',Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$ form a chosen Cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product; def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let $r$ be a strict tower ringed-square presentation, so that its upper pullback is native inverse image along $g'$ with its specified coefficient isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations; def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. If $g$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], then this upper pullback preserves K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]: the termwise image of every K-injective complex on $X$ is K-injective on $X'$.

source.place: Tag 08FI, lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open; proetale.tex Tag 09A5, section-morphism; sites.tex Tag 00XZ, section-localize.

proof.text: The chosen square identifies g prime with the first projection of the pullback of g along f, preceded by the chosen Cartesian isomorphism. Open immersions are stable under base change and composition with isomorphisms, so g prime is open.
Apply native open pullback preservation to g prime, the coefficient ring r.RX, the ring r.RX prime and the specified coefficient isomorphism r.cg prime. This functor is exactly upperPull r.
